title: Vercel extended Spend Management budget controls to Enterprise Flexible Commitment plans
detail: Spend Management, previously available on Pro, is now included at no additional cost for Enterprise teams on Flexible Commitment plans. Admins can set a budget per billing cycle; when metered usage approaches or crosses it, Spend Management can send email notifications, trigger a webhook, or pause the production deployments of all projects. Setting a budget does not pause usage on its own, and pausing does not stop AI Gateway or v0 usage.
impact: If your Enterprise plan is Flexible Commitment rather than a fixed contract, you now have the same opt-in cost-capping tools Pro customers have had. It only pauses project deployments, so a spend spike coming from AI Gateway or v0 keeps billing even with a budget pause enabled.
